name: West Sacramento Home Run Paid Summer Internships
org: West Sacramento Home Run and City of West Sacramento
what_you_do: Apply and interview for a paid summer internship with a local employer. The Home Run team gives work readiness training and the city pays you.
who_can_apply: Washington Unified School District high school students who are 16 by the first day. River City HS students need a Career Technical Education course; Yolo HS and Washington Middle College students need a teacher or counselor recommendation. Everyone attends one online info session.
pay_detail: Paid by the City of West Sacramento, up to 40 hours per week. Hourly rate not posted on the page.
duration: summer, up to 40 hours per week
deadline_text: The 2026 Internship Calendar is an image on the page (not readable here). 2027 dates not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Go to the Internships page, attend the info session, send the recommendation form if needed, then apply and interview with employers.
notes: Employers have included Center for Land Based Learning, Elica Health Centers, City of West Sacramento and others. The 2026 calendar on the page is an image, so ask for 2027 dates: wshomerun@cityofwestsacramento.org or (916) 617-4500.
